title: hovenia dulcis f. latifolia
intro: Hovenia dulcis f. latifolia, commonly known as Chinese raisin or Renga in Japanese, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to promote liver health, improve digestion, and detoxify the body. The health benefits of Hovenia dulcis f. latifolia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties, which help to reduce liver damage and improve liver function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
